name: Task Context Prefetch
description: Before a phase session spawns, startTaskPhase / startTaskPhaseBatch (commands/taskFlow.ts) call deps.prefetchContext(worktree, task), wired in extension.ts to taskContext.buildTaskContext. It searches arch cards (scanHost.searchArchCards, top 3, expanded via archHost.readAllArchCards) and code symbols (scanHost.searchCode, top 5) with title + first 300 chars of the description, each under a 5s timeout (failure → less context), and renders at most ~2 KB via the pure formatTaskContext. phasePrompt(phase, task, context?) / phasePromptBulk(phase, tasks, contexts?) append it as "## Context (prefetched, verify before relying on it)" before the procedure. Toggle: codeWorkbench.taskFlow.prefetchContext (default true).
guidelines: Prefetch is best-effort: never let a search failure or timeout block a phase start.
Keep the rendered context under CONTEXT_MAX_CHARS.
anti_patterns: Do not inline unbounded search output into a prompt.
